items.q: How does the collaboration process with Digifolks work?
items.a: We start with a discovery session to deeply understand your operational challenges. Then, we design an architecture blueprint, conduct iterative development (Agile), through to deployment and continuous maintenance.

items.q: Does Digifolks handle maintenance after the system goes live?
items.a: Yes. We provide enterprise-level SLA (Service Level Agreement) that includes 24/7 monitoring, routine maintenance, and proactive technical support.

items.q: How long does it typically take to develop a system?
items.a: Development time depends heavily on system complexity. An MVP (Minimum Viable Product) typically takes 3-4 months, while full-scale enterprise systems can take 6-12 months.
